findings.evidence: Workflow is a five-step process (route, extract, design, review, save) but step 5's checklist is prose, not a checkpoint list, and there is no validation pass before the plan is presented
findings.fix: Add a short checklist at step 5 the agent marks before presenting: source or provisional heading, lessons each with a testable artifact, Rep 1 done-when controllable, learning metric separate, process measure present when outcomes are noisy, steps inside the time budget including setup, later reps one line each; this fits the process pattern the workflow already follows

findings.evidence: "Increase difficulty based on success" and "Keep reps shippable (not theoretical)" with no reason a reviewer would not already assume
findings.fix: Tie each principle to the failure it prevents: raising difficulty on a noisy or inconsistent rep hides the lesson (point at the review rows), and a theoretical rep produces no artifact so step 4's first row can never fire

findings.evidence: description names content types and trigger phrases but no keyword for a rep log, a rep report file, or an existing plan file being updated
findings.fix: Turn articles, tutorials, YouTube transcripts, talks, course notes or a rep log into a Ship-Learn-Next plan: a first rep the user can ship within their time budget, with controllable completion criteria, reflection questions and provisional next reps; also reviews a reported rep's results, including an appended update to an existing plan file, to choose the next rep. Use when the user says "make this actionable", "I watched/read X, now what?", "help me actually implement this advice", "turn my notes into something I can ship", pastes a rep log, or reports how a rep went and asks what to do next. Not for summaries or key takeaways, reading lists, curricula, exam-study schedules, or project and sprint plans that do not start from learning content.

findings.evidence: "When several compete for Rep 1, pick the one with the smallest shippable test inside the user's available time" gives no tie-break when two lessons have the same smallest test

findings.evidence: 20 queries (10 should-trigger, 10 should-not-trigger) with near-misses, but no query pastes rep results or names an existing plan file, which is half of what the skill does
findings.fix: Replace one generic should-trigger query with a rep-report prompt that pastes results and asks whether to repeat or advance, and one that asks to append a review to an existing Ship-Learn-Next plan file

findings.evidence: "Usable evidence (a causal comparison): the result moved the metric the plan named by more than the sample's noise" never says how to judge the noise, so the noisy-outcome row and the usable-evidence row are not separable on a number
findings.fix: Add one rule: the user or the source supplies the noise band or the sample the plan treats as decisive; with neither, the evidence is too thin and the rep repeats, and the agent never computes a significance test the plan did not specify
